author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭವಿತವ್ಯ ಹಸನಾಗಲೆಂಬ ಕನಸುಗಳಿರಲು
ತವಕದಲಿ ದಾರಿಗಳ ಹುಡುಕುವುದು ಸಹಜ
ಬವಣೆಗಳ ಭೇದಿಸುವ ಕ್ಷಮತೆಹೊಂದಿರಲಾಗ
ಸವಿಗನಸು ಸಾಕಾರ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When you dream of a brighter future,
it is natural to search eagerly for the way;
if you have the strength to break through hardships,
your sweet dream takes shape, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Dreams of a better future send us looking for a path. Resilience in the face of difficulty is what turns those dreams into reality.
